lina_cs: Quick note  EmberQ (onboarding) needs APAC allowlist + transient rate bump for partner showcase tomorrow 08:00 SGT. Expected load ~1500 reqs over 20m. Also account flagged as renewal-risk (low usage 30d).
ashley_net: Do they have static egress? CIDR or header allowlist?
kai_specterfold: we can provide CIDR 203.0.114.0/27 and header fallback. Traffic from sg-proxy.
miguel_ops: Need exact times, burst vs sustained QPS, and p95 target.
kai_specterfold: Start 2026-04-05T08:00:00+08:00, duration 30m. burst 80 req/s, sustained 35 req/s. Target p95 <180ms.
lina_cs: CS will send feedback survey + schedule enablement if demo goes well. Renewal in ~4w.
ashley_net: i'll prepare temp rule scoped to sg-edge with auto-expire + revoke.
miguel_ops: adding fallback route to small model on latency breach >250ms and enable KV prefix caching.
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-5901: "EmberQ SG allowlist + transient bump" (expires 2026-04-05T09:00:00+08:00).
lina_cs: please capture demo metrics and add to renewal playbook.
miguel_ops: done
